\mxunit{enrichment-modular-problems}{Congruences and last digits}
\mxsubtitle{High school · number theory \textperiodcentered{} Synthesis problem \textperiodcentered{} 03}

\begin{problem}[Investigate, justify, conclude]
An integer N is congruent to 2 modulo 3 and to 3 modulo 5. Write $N = 3k + 2$, determine k modulo 5, then give all solutions modulo 15. Which solutions from 0 to 100 inclusive are even?
\end{problem}
